Messages.Author: Nac
Messages.Body:
Hi

Does priority comes back after other players block attempts? Player A does an indirect action, player B fails, player c fails, can player B ether block or play cards while on "block attempts?
(Rulebook sys it is final but every other priority in the game says otherwise so I ask)

Many thanks in advance

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Nac wrote:
> Hi
>
> Does priority comes back after other players block attempts? Player A does an indirect action, player B fails, player c fails, can player B ether block or play cards while on "block attempts?
> (Rulebook sys it is final but every other priority in the game says otherwise so I ask)
>
> Many thanks in advance
>
No. C can only start their block attempts once B has declined to block, and that decision is final.

www.vekn.net/rulebook#who-may-attempt-to-block
>
> rulebook wrote:
> If one attempt to block fails, another can be made as often as the blocking Methuselah wishes.
>
> Once a Methuselah decides not to make any further attempts to block, that decision is final.
>
